# BCGov Crow - v0.15.3

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Reworked the `crow-raven-setup` skill into a guided onboarding flow for Raven
MCP servers, where credentials are entered in the terminal and never pass
through chat. The skill now follows the Agent Skills folder layout and ships
the credential scripts it needs.

## Highlights

- Guided Raven setup: choose servers or a starter set, enter credentials in
  the terminal, then confirm each server with a read-only check.
- Per-server guides under `references/servers/` covering the credential type,
  URL format and verification calls. The Atlassian Cloud path (Jira and
  Confluence) is verified end to end, including the `*.atlassian.net` URL and
  Classic API token requirements.
- Credential scripts are bundled in the skill with `--set`, `--sections` and
  `--raven-runtime` options for agent-driven runs. A provenance reference
  records their origin and SHA-256 digests.
- Skill folders now use `references/` and `assets/` in place of `modules/` and
  `resources/`, matching the Agent Skills layout.

## Changes

- Added `references/credentials-servers.md` and one guide per Raven server,
  and moved the provenance document from `scripts/` to `references/`.
- Added coding-convention headers and function documentation to all
  `crow-raven-setup` scripts. These are comments only, with no logic changes.
- Updated the package file list so the credential scripts ship with the skill.
- Align full-package, plugin, and collection versions at 0.15.3.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: passed; 271 files selected for packaging.
- Archive inspection: pending package build; no archive or checksum has been
  created for this draft.
- Additional checks: `crow-raven-setup` tests passed (55 passed, 1 skipped) and
  the skill audit passed. Jira and Confluence read calls were verified with
  credentials stored in the macOS keychain. Other servers' credential flows,
  Linux and Windows parity for the new options, and a Sonar scan are not
  covered.

## Installation

Once the versioned release is published, install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.15.3 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive after it is built:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.15.3.zip --global --target copilot
```
